name: Exp_JSatl_Digit_System
summary: This EA implements a trend-following trading system based on the JSatl (Jurik Satl) digital filter indicator, which combines Jurik-style smoothing with adaptive trend-line analysis to identify and follow market trends. It generates buy and sell signals when the JSatl indicator changes direction or crosses threshold levels, opening positions in the direction of the detected trend. The system includes configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters along with position sizing controls.
summary_zh: 该EA基于JSatl（Jurik Satl）数字滤波指标实现趋势跟踪交易系统，结合Jurik风格平滑与自适应趋势线分析来识别和跟随市场趋势。当JSatl指标改变方向或穿越阈值水平时，产生买入和卖出信号，沿检测到的趋势方向开仓。系统包含可配置的止损止盈参数及仓位管理控制。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于JSatl数字滤波指标，该指标融合了Jurik平滑算法与自适应趋势线技术，旨在过滤市场噪音并捕捉主趋势方向。入场条件依赖JSatl指标的方向变化——当指标由下降转为上升时产生买入信号，由上升转为下降时产生卖出信号，本质上是一种趋势反转跟踪策略。出场条件通过固定止损和止盈参数实现，当价格触及预设水平时自动平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数模式，允许用户通过参数设置每笔交易的手数大小。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和保证金比例检查，但缺乏动态仓位调整机制如ATR-based仓位计算。整体策略逻辑清晰，但过于依赖单一指标的信号质量，在震荡市中可能频繁产生虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the JSatl digital filter indicator, which integrates Jurik smoothing algorithms with adaptive trend-line technology to filter market noise and capture the main trend direction. Entry conditions rely on the JSatl indicator's directional changes—a buy signal is generated when the indicator turns from declining to rising, and a sell signal when it turns from rising to declining, essentially a trend-reversal tracking approach. Exit conditions are implemented through fixed stop-loss and take-profit parameters, automatically closing positions when price reaches preset levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot mode, allowing users to set the lot size for each trade via input parameters. Money management provides maximum position limits and margin ratio checks, but lacks dynamic position sizing mechanisms such as ATR-based lot calculation. The overall strategy logic is clear, but it is overly dependent on the signal quality of a single indicator, which may frequently generate false signals in ranging markets.

pros: 基于Jurik平滑算法的JSatl指标能有效过滤市场噪音，信号质量优于普通移动平均线
策略逻辑简单清晰，参数数量适中，便于用户理解和调优
包含止损止盈设置和最大持仓限制，具备基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: The JSatl indicator based on Jurik smoothing algorithm effectively filters market noise, providing better signal quality than standard moving averages
The strategy logic is simple and clear with a moderate number of parameters, making it easy for users to understand and optimize
Includes stop-loss and take-profit settings along with maximum position limits, providing a basic risk control framework
cons: 过度依赖单一指标信号，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
采用固定手数而非动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动率自动调整风险敞口
缺乏趋势强度过滤和多时间周期确认机制，容易在弱趋势或趋势转折点入场
cons_en: Over-reliance on a single indicator signal makes it prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Uses fixed lot sizing instead of dynamic position management, unable to automatically adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
Lacks trend strength filtering and multi-timeframe confirmation, making it easy to enter during weak trends or trend reversal points
improvements: 增加多时间周期确认机制，如在大周期趋势方向一致时才允许入场信号，提高信号可靠性
引入ATR动态止损和动态仓位管理，根据市场波动率自动调整止损距离和交易手数
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism, only allowing entry signals when the higher-timeframe trend direction aligns, improving signal reliability
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and dynamic position sizing, automatically adjusting stop distance and trade lot size based on market volatility

risk_points: 单一指标在震荡市中频繁产生虚假信号，可能导致连续小额亏损累积
固定止损未考虑市场波动率，在高波动期可能止损过近被扫损，在低波动期止损过远浪费利润空间
risk_points_en: Single indicator frequently generates false signals in ranging markets, potentially leading to accumulated consecutive small losses
Fixed stop-loss does not account for market volatility—too close during high volatility causing premature stops, too far during low volatility wasting profit potential
